stemBlocks:
A pendulum bob of mass 10g is suspended by a light, inextensible string of length 50 cm.
The bob is released from rest at position X.
What is the speed of the bob as it passes through position Y?
(gravitational field strength $g = 10 \text{ N kg}^{-1}$; assume that resistive forces are negligible)

assets.alt: A pendulum with string length 50 cm. The bob is released from rest at position X. Position Y is the lowest point of the swing. The horizontal distance between the vertical line through X and the vertical line through Y is 30 cm.
